name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
summary: DRC is Tenure Facility’s largest project footprint, where community forest concessions, governance structures, and institutional strengthening are scaling in parallel.
featured_achievements: Simple management plans for 12 community forest concessions were validated and submitted.
CAGDFT advanced tenure rights progress over 306,263 hectares and formal recognition over 166,631 hectares.
Community governance bodies supported by CAGDFT now include at least three women each.

stories.title: Community concessions at scale
stories.summary: Community-led planning in Mai-Ndombe, Kwilu, and Sud Ubangi strengthened rights and conservation with formal governance pathways.

stories.title: UEFA financial transformation
stories.summary: UEFA moved from constrained administration toward scalable grant management, including a five-year financial plan.

quote.text: You can’t provide someone with the right to self-determination unless you take a risk.
